TX.name: Telehealth Visit - Texas
TX.desc:
Private real-time video visit with a licensed provider for patients who are physically located in Texas at the time of the visit. Available in Texas: medical weight loss (including GLP-1 medicines), compounded peptide therapy, hormone and wellness consultations, and Vyleesi. Prescriptions are not guaranteed.

Fee: $100, paid when you book. Non-refundable, including if you cancel, miss your visit or your provider decides not to prescribe. Refund policy: 713botoxme.com/online/refund-policy

All appointment times are shown in Central time.
